function pgStr(v) { return v === null || v === undefined || v === '' ? 'NULL' : `'` + String(v).replace(/'/g, `''`) + `'`; }

const j = $json;
const sql = `INSERT INTO trading.market_context_history
  (symbol, snapshot_date, name, markt_typ, region, waehrung, referenz_fuer, zeitstempel, type, aktueller_kurs, veraenderung_abs, veraenderung_pct, rsi, rsi_signal, macd, macd_signal_linie, macd_histogramm, macd_signal, trend, ema20, bb_oben, bb_mitte, bb_unten, kurs_bei_bollinger, signal_punkte, signal_gruende, signal_staerke, markt_status, risk_level, markt_hinweis, quelle, status, fehler)
  VALUES (${pgStr(j.symbol)}, ${pgStr(j.datum)}, ${pgStr(j.name)}, ${pgStr(j.markt_typ)}, ${pgStr(j.region)}, ${pgStr(j.waehrung)}, ${pgStr(j.referenz_fuer)}, ${pgStr(j.zeitstempel)}, ${pgStr(j.type)}, ${pgStr(j.aktueller_kurs)}, ${pgStr(j.veraenderung_abs)}, ${pgStr(j.veraenderung_pct)}, ${pgStr(j.rsi)}, ${pgStr(j.rsi_signal)}, ${pgStr(j.macd)}, ${pgStr(j.macd_signal_linie)}, ${pgStr(j.macd_histogramm)}, ${pgStr(j.macd_signal)}, ${pgStr(j.trend)}, ${pgStr(j.ema20)}, ${pgStr(j.bb_oben)}, ${pgStr(j.bb_mitte)}, ${pgStr(j.bb_unten)}, ${pgStr(j.kurs_bei_bollinger)}, ${pgStr(j.signal_punkte)}, ${pgStr(j.signal_gruende)}, ${pgStr(j.signal_staerke)}, ${pgStr(j.markt_status)}, ${pgStr(j.risk_level)}, ${pgStr(j.markt_hinweis)}, ${pgStr(j.quelle)}, ${pgStr(j.status)}, ${pgStr(j.fehler)})
  ON CONFLICT (symbol, snapshot_date) DO UPDATE SET
    name = EXCLUDED.name,
    markt_typ = EXCLUDED.markt_typ,
    region = EXCLUDED.region,
    waehrung = EXCLUDED.waehrung,
    referenz_fuer = EXCLUDED.referenz_fuer,
    zeitstempel = EXCLUDED.zeitstempel,
    type = EXCLUDED.type,
    aktueller_kurs = EXCLUDED.aktueller_kurs,
    veraenderung_abs = EXCLUDED.veraenderung_abs,
    veraenderung_pct = EXCLUDED.veraenderung_pct,
    rsi = EXCLUDED.rsi,
    rsi_signal = EXCLUDED.rsi_signal,
    macd = EXCLUDED.macd,
    macd_signal_linie = EXCLUDED.macd_signal_linie,
    macd_histogramm = EXCLUDED.macd_histogramm,
    macd_signal = EXCLUDED.macd_signal,
    trend = EXCLUDED.trend,
    ema20 = EXCLUDED.ema20,
    bb_oben = EXCLUDED.bb_oben,
    bb_mitte = EXCLUDED.bb_mitte,
    bb_unten = EXCLUDED.bb_unten,
    kurs_bei_bollinger = EXCLUDED.kurs_bei_bollinger,
    signal_punkte = EXCLUDED.signal_punkte,
    signal_gruende = EXCLUDED.signal_gruende,
    signal_staerke = EXCLUDED.signal_staerke,
    markt_status = EXCLUDED.markt_status,
    risk_level = EXCLUDED.risk_level,
    markt_hinweis = EXCLUDED.markt_hinweis,
    quelle = EXCLUDED.quelle,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    fehler = EXCLUDED.fehler,
    fetched_at = now();`;

return { json: { ...j, sql } };

parameters.query: SELECT ni.title AS titel, v.wirkungsebene, v.direction AS wirkungsrichtung, v.effect_level AS wirkung_staerke, v.category AS news_kategorie FROM trading.v_news_latest_assessment v JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = v.news_id WHERE v.relevance = TRUE AND v.wirkungsebene IN ('markt', 'makro') AND (ni.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date;
